correctness.rationale: The graph is the 24-vertex cubic LCF [-12,7,-7]^8 with 36 undirected edges and girth 7. Every unordered nonempty proper vertex bipartition has exactly one representative containing vertex 0, hence exactly 2^23-1=8,388,607 tested masks. The boundary identity |delta S|=3|S|-2|E(S)| and DSU/DFS e>=v criterion are exact. Independently rebuilt the graph and executed a new exhaustive 8,388,607-mask C++ subset enumeration (not simply the package output); it obtained 32 size-7 and 362 size-8 cyclic cuts, all sides connected. Size-8 side size distribution is 258 at size8 (34 induced 8-cycles, 224 7-cycle+pendant), 80 size10 theta paths 3,4,4, and 24 size12 K4 subdivisions. Independent graph-isomorphism and automorphism partition checks gave |Aut(G)|=32, 21 orbits and 6 AA, 16 AB, 2 BB balanced pairs. Counts certify the finite classification, not an all-cage generalization.

This finite classification is substantive, reproducible and can support later structural graph investigations; not an arbitrary isolated mask table.
